items.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Steve Allen — I was lucky to interview Steve Allen years ago.

ctx.x: to turn them into themes or things like that. But there was a definite — I think maybe the most telling thing is that you know it’s a waltz but on the top of the music for the players it says “Funky Yet Graceful.” And so I was trying to find something that had some blues elements in it, with chords that moved in slightly unusual ways for a jazz waltz. But also a certain grace in terms of things not being too herky jerky but things moving smoothly. So I mean I think that was kind of the approach on it was that I…

Steve Allen — I was lucky to interview Steve Allen years ago. And I asked him about song titles. Like do they usually have a meaning. And Steve Allen had strong opinions. And he said, “I should say that there’s really no meaning, nor could there be any meaning to a pure melody. So then he went on to say a melody could have a mood but I always remember that because sometimes song titles are hard. I’m going to ask a question that’s going to sound almost like it could be an insult but it’s not.
